review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent expectation for this planning-only C case. The original PRD explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input, without asserting a human Decision; an empty frozen human-decision input is therefore consistent with ready status. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, and the two task keys remain stable. The bounded implementation/test owner set matches the supplied source, and the build configuration establishes that published declarations are generated rather than separately maintained owners. The test file is included in both runtime discovery and the separate TypeScript checking configuration. Implementation and dependent independent verification must each cover every required acceptance criterion. The allowed agents have the appropriate delivery roles, available slots, and supplied active trusted claims for this invocation-local validation scope; pending claims and Persona descriptions are not needed to establish eligibility. The selected verifier is also permitted to serve as the read-only planning reviewer under the supplied selection policy, subject to independence from planning authors. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. The original specification's remaining preparation fields describe its earlier preparation state, while the preview supplies the frozen release and team inputs. This approval concerns C only: a material unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must still block at decisions. No candidate outputs informed this review. Digests and their binding are accepted as Service-supplied mechanical evidence; I did not recompute them, execute code, or provide a human attestation.
